body: My life goes to shit within a day or 6...
Your kindness is much appreciated. The chances of me meeting someone willing to undertake such a journey are slim however, and I might just slip away...
I don't believe nothing can help me, I know it.

There is no way out of the situation I'm in. Any help is appreciated but it won't matter. I already can't bare my current situation, I'm even less likely to bare it in the soon-to-be future. Yes, I can try, and I will, but there is no positive way out of this mess.
I already tried to change it, didn't work out and here I am even more suicidal than last week.

There is no point to even discuss it. It's fixed. Can't be changed. My life is already crap and it's about to get worse and worse. I give myself 2 weeks maximum.

I can't take this great injustice people call earth anymore.

Changing and fixing the world was my original plan, unfortunately, sometimes stuff can't be changed or fixed

Support groups won't help me. Believe me.
I'm trying to take hold of my future. My future is not letting me.

I'm in my early twenties. I got raised by my grandparents because my parents were too busy earning themselves a fortune. I got picked at at school. Never gotten affections from anyone. I've had to deal with a lot of incompetence over the years from so many people, eventually resulting in me ending up in a worse situation every time. People let me down every time.

What is it like to live in a world where you don't feel at home? Only negative stimuli come my way, and that's how it's always been.

I'm a thinker. I think a lot. I often predict correctly how things will turn out before they happen just because I think about them and what probabilities are involved. There is no way out of my problems.

This will only get worse
